capability_limits.name: VS15 text-presentation fallback
capability_limits.metal_result: strict probe failed on three unexpected font IDs
capability_limits.cause: Parley 0.9.0 src/shape/mod.rs:237-266 classifies pictographs as emoji without VS15 handling; :550-577 prioritizes emoji generic over script fallback.

requirement_audit.detail: Fresh five-run Metal baseline; four full final matrices per backend. Existing fidelity report/manifest remain historical.

34 distinct formerly missing sequences exercised with host discovery disabled; required resolved faces and support asserted. Three licensed, renamed, hash-pinned subsets; full source metrics/rasters compared.

Raw unbounded atlas pixels; expected baseline from font metrics; minimum fitting translations; independently specified asymmetric/tie oversized tests; occupancy and every neighboring cell checked. Final review rejects absent allowed crop placement.

12 supported CBDT color sequences over two backgrounds, nonwhite foreground, alpha and one-glyph assertions. VS16/modifier/ZWJ/flag/keycap coverage passes. VS15 text fallback is unsupported by Parley 0.9.0; strict failing probe retained and capability remains outstanding under section 4 allowance, never counted as passing.

8 stages x 24 cases/backend; fractional sizes/rounding scales, mixed faces, line height, fixed cells, font/content changes, logical/physical geometry, stable handles, idle counters/pixels. Existing box joins and procedural fills pass; intentional crops classified.

CJK baseline 28 versus primary 26 reproduced; cached ordinary glyphs translated to common baseline. No public API, second engine, per-frame font scan, or content-dependent sizing added. Existing GPU/unit/consumer suites pass. Ghostty reference revision pinned in report; no copied renderer code.

requirement_audit.requirement: 7. Verification, CI, consumers, review and deliverables
requirement_audit.detail: Required local checks pass; software Vulkan and Metal tested. Full-diff self-review of production/harness/fonts/docs/CI plus final affected-check reruns. CI coverage step and diagnostics added locally. No GitHub publication requested/performed. Explicit upstream capability limitation remains documented, not represented as fixed.

review.scope: all changed renderer, harness, fixture, CI and documentation files

limitations: VS15 is explicitly outstanding; selected supported cases do not prove every Unicode sequence/font/color format.
GPU shutdown emits closed-readback-channel warnings after successful application exit.
